title: Mine Eyes Have Seen the Glory

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Bb]Mine eyes have seen the glory of the coming [Eb/Bb]of the Lord;
[Eb]He is [Bb]trampling out the vintage where the grapes of wrath are stored;
[Bb]He hath loosed the [Cm/Eb]fateful [F/C]lightning [Gm/D]of [Bb]his terrible swift sword;

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Bb]He has sounded forth the trumpet that shall never [Eb/Bb]call retreat;
[Eb]He is [Bb]sifting out the hearts of men before His judgment seat;
[Bb]O be swift, [Cm/Eb]my soul, [Gm/D]to [F/C]answer [Gm/D]Him! [Bb]be jubilant, my feet!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Bb]In the beauty of the lilies Christ was born [Eb/Bb]across the sea,
[Eb]With a [Bb]glory in His bosom that transfigures you and me;
[Bb]As He died [Cm/Eb]to make [Gm/D]men [F/C]holy, [Gm/D]let [Bb]us live to make men free!
